summary: Five separate out-of-charset stems (Scrollback uppercase, codex_scrollback underscore, codex.scrollback dot, 'codex scrollback' space, codex-scroellback non-ASCII) each assert a violation whose rule is specifically REQ-011.1.2 from the real parseSpec, and two negative controls (the valid hyphenated stem, and codex-2fa-scrollback) assert the rule does NOT fire, so neither an under- nor an over-broad charset check survives.
